title: What If You Lived in a Cave With No Clock?

scenes.text: What if you lived underground with no clock? Your body keeps time. Your mind loses it.
In 1962, French scientist Michel Siffre spent 63 days in a cave. He thought it was August 20th. It was mid-September.
His body clock settled near 24 and a half hours, so his days quietly drifted.
In 1972 he spent 205 days in a Texas cave, tracking his sleep and hormones.
In 2000, after 76 days in a French cave, he thought it was February 5th. It was the 14th.
Without sunlight, humans don't lose time. We just run on a clock that's slightly off.
